title: The chosen display follows the user to new sign-ins, devices and locations
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. S1-702 led by Esther Howard):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose a customer (e.g. "Fibridge Commercial") and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
  6. Make sure your user is enrolled at a second location (Settings > Staff > open your staff record > add the second location, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Location 2"; if no second location exists, create one first: Settings > Locations > add a location > Save > Save).
  7. Have a second browser (or another computer) available.
  8. Have a second user with Work Orders view who has never changed the display (e.g. a Service Advisor). Add one in Settings > Staff if needed.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (in the design its tooltip reads "Board").
  3. Sign out, then sign in again as the same user.
  4. Open Work Orders and note the display.
  5. In the second browser, sign in as the same user and open Work Orders. Note the display.
  6. In the top bar switch to the second location (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST Location 2) and open Work Orders. Note the display.
  7. Sign out and sign in as the second user. Open Work Orders and note the display.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After signing in again, Work Orders opens in Board View.
  • In the second browser, Work Orders opens in Board View.
  • At the second location, Work Orders opens in Board View.
  • The second user still sees List: the choice was saved for your user only.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R4, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions Confluence 853901313, DR-6 (display option persists across locations).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R4: “Save the selected display option per user. It follows the user after logout/login, on other devices, and in other locations.”
